lede: Thanksgiving week lands squarely in the middle of this stretch, and the valley is leaning into it — the Turkey Trot kicks off Thursday morning, Alloy Kitchen is hosting an Outlaw Thanksgiving, and the mountain opens up for Will Ski 4 Food on Saturday. On the government side, both the County Commissioners work session and the Mountain Village Metro District board meeting have agendas that haven't been posted yet, so there's nothing pressing to track at the dais this week.
